mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Create a new ABAP object: a class, program, CDS view, table, function module, package or another type.

description: Creates the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …): sends the create request for its type with the given parameters, and answers SAP's result. The object is created inactive. object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*, super_package*), DOMAIN(domain_name*, package_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*, package_name*), TRANSPORT(description*), TABLE(table_name*, package_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*, package_name*), DDL(ddl_name*, package_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*, package_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*, service_definition_name*, package_name*), CLASS(class_name*, package_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*, package_name*) [onprem only], INTERFACE(interface_name*, package_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*, package_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name*, function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(name*, package_name*, implementation_type*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(class_name*, package_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(name*, package_name*). Optional for every type: description, transport_request. When object_type is one of DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TRANSPORT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION; or object_type is PACKAGE and the connection is HTTP, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

binding_variant.description: Binding variant (SERVICE_BINDING create); ODATA_V4_UI when absent.

ddl_name.description: DDL source name (CDS view, AMDP table function, etc.).

function_group_name.description: ABAP function group name (FUNCTION_GROUP; the group of a FUNCTION_MODULE).

master_language.description: Original language of the created object; the session language when absent.

name.description: Object name for handlers that require a generic `name` (behavior definition, metadata extension).

object_type.description: ABAP object type for routed compact operation.

owner.description: Owner of the transport request (TRANSPORT create).

service_definition_name.description: Service definition name (SERVICE_DEFINITION; the definition a SERVICE_BINDING binds).

service_name.description: Service name of the binding (SERVICE_BINDING create); the binding name when absent.

service_version.description: Service version of the binding (SERVICE_BINDING create); 0001 when absent.

target_system.description: Target system of the transport request (TRANSPORT create).

transport_request.description: Transport request id (if required by system).

name: HandlerCreate
